promises.summary: Mum and Joe can privately capture/upload a photo (one selected bird with crop/zoom) or a recording (stop early or 60-second cap), with capture date/location retained or corrected.
Every bird identification shows an honest model score and needs confirmation; rejected identifications can be corrected by catalogue search attached to evidence. No standalone manual entries.
Confirmed sightings form a persistent collection with original photos/recordings, history, and deletion; retries do not duplicate entries.

The web app preserves AvianVisitors' illustrated design and controls a 480x800 portrait collage in weekly, all-time rotation, and manual up-to-six modes; a Pi 3 A+ fetches changed images and retains its last good display.

The system is operable as a hosted private web app with a recoverable data store, repeatable deployment, and a device setup guide; meaningful tests and independent audits prove the software. Physical Pi/panel checks remain pending until delivery.
